=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:432-446
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The initial `rm -f` cleanup runs before the early-return guards, so it executes even when baseline capture will not run.
  WHY: It is harmless with the current per-run path, but several reviewers flagged the ordering as unnecessary and potentially destructive if the runtime path becomes shared.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:443-458 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The baseline capture failure warning is too generic and does not surface the underlying exit-code details.
  WHY: Reviewers reported that operators cannot tell which class of Python failure caused the fallback, though deepseek/moonshot said the current code already includes the exit code and treated this path as fixed.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:681-695
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The warning text says "than were captured" even when compare mode uses a different denominator.
  WHY: The numeric ratio is correct, but the prose can mislead operators about what the compare-mode warning is referencing.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:1040-1064 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: In `compare_against_baseline()`, `must_contain` fingerprints with `check_error` are counted in `mc_compare_expected` before the error guard, skewing the ratio denominator.
  WHY: This makes the satisfaction percentage look lower on unreadable or out-of-tree fingerprints; deepseek said the latest diff already fixes this, but the other reviewers still reported the bug.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:1040-1055 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Current-only `check_error` states append to `violations` without a structured marker that distinguishes unreadable paths from content mismatches.
  WHY: Operators cannot quickly tell whether the failure is a pre-existing access problem or a resolver regression.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:132-145 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The containment check can be bypassed by a symlinked fingerprint path that resolves outside the repo root on some filesystems.
  WHY: A crafted fingerprint JSON could let the verifier read host files; the other reviewers did not flag this risk.
- docs/completed/integration-sync-resolver-self-heal-plan.md:3-5 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The status header says "Phase 1 shipped / archived reference copy" while the plan still labels later phases as follow-up work.
  WHY: Minimax said this overstates what has shipped, while x-ai_grok treated the wording as accurate shipped-vs-follow-up framing.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
